The main takeaway from our work is that

exploratory structural equation models should be considered in place of confirmatory factor models when evaluating the construct validity of test scores, particularly when a priori factor structure of the test is unknown.
researchers who use the Academic Motivation Scales should use exploratory structural equation models rather than confirmatory models when assessing the construct validity of their scores.
